meta_tools.name: codespar_charge
meta_tools.description: Propose the receivable(s) of an agreement the payer accepted: one instalment per bolepix (cobranca com vencimento: the payer settles by Pix or by boleto). This does NOT issue anything: it creates an execution in `drafted` that the code checks against the collection policy and the negotiation envelope (discount ceiling, instalment count, due-date window, collection hours) and, depending on the approval mode, asks the operator or issues. The code builds the real call (`POST /v1/charges`, `method: boleto`, the debtor's name and document from the agreement, `idempotency_key` per instalment) and presents the QR and the copy-and-paste; you never see or pass a document. action=status reads back the state of a receivable this run issued.

action.description: create (the default) proposes the receivables; status reads one back.

agreement.description: The agreement alias from list_agreements (acordo-1042). Never a name, a document or a Pix key typed in the chat.

instalments.description: One entry per instalment, in order. A single entry is a payment in full.

total_minor.description: Optional. What you believe the total is. The code recomputes it and yours is only recorded.

local_tools.name: list_agreements
local_tools.description: The open agreements this merchant collects: alias, debtor's first name, principal in BRL cents, origin, and the envelope you may negotiate inside (maximum discount, maximum instalments, due-date window). Read-only. Documents are not returned.
